records.name: Milo Bristle
records.biography_en: Milo Bristle works the Brush Detail with The Morning After. When a player leaves another HyperNorm block in pieces, the crew returns with familiar tools and a fresh estimate. Milo Bristle takes pride in leaving one small part of the district easier to live in.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Milo Bristle has seen this corner before. The building was facing another direction then.
